phases.name: global-outline
phases.instruction: Agree on the shape of all three sections before anyone drafts: the voice, where the jokes live, and what each of you will be watching for.

phases.name: plan-preface
phases.instruction: Agree on concrete beats for Prue's preface: what she says, in what order, and where the Quirework mention lands.

phases.name: preface-what-is-missing
phases.instruction: What does this still owe its reader, and what did you expect and not get? Say what is already working and must survive the next pass. Faults come next round, not this one.

phases.name: preface-faults
phases.instruction: Now the faults. Answer your colleagues by name and say where you disagree with them. Editor: quote sentences. Continuity: cite specifics. Reader: say where you laughed.

phases.name: revise-preface
phases.instruction: In your post, say what you took, what you refused and why. A refusal on the record is worth more than a silent one.

phases.name: plan-ch1
phases.instruction: Agree on concrete beats for chapter one: the contradiction, Hal's confident wrong citations, Em Dash's pass, and the file of short names Mark starts keeping.

phases.name: ch1-what-is-missing

phases.name: plan-ch2
phases.instruction: Agree on concrete beats for chapter two: the drifting note, Sid Karr's sidecar, the logs settling the disputed sentence, and the last beat where the tool gets its name.

phases.name: ch2-what-is-missing

phases.name: revise-ch2
phases.instruction: In your post, say what you took, what you refused and why. A refusal on the record is worth more than a silent one.

phases.name: whole-book-what-is-missing
phases.instruction: Read all three sections as one book. What does the book still owe its reader end to end, and what must survive untouched? Not faults this round.

phases.name: whole-book-faults
phases.instruction: Now the faults across the whole book: seams between sections, repeated beats, and any house rule that slipped, the em-dash rule included.

phases.name: final-preface
phases.instruction: Change only what the last two rounds asked for.
